assertions.assertion: Program.cs sets options.UserInteraction.CreateAccountUrl to '/Account/Register' in AddIdentityServer
assertions.rationale: The response never sets options.UserInteraction.CreateAccountUrl; instead it manually inspects context.Parameters["prompt"] in the login page and redirects, missing the supported host configuration.

assertions.assertion: Response notes that this makes IdentityServer advertise 'create' in prompt_values_supported (discovery) and that prompt=create is ignored if CreateAccountUrl is unset
assertions.rationale: It vaguely says to make discovery 'list it', but does not mention prompt_values_supported by name nor that prompt=create is ignored when CreateAccountUrl is unset.

assertions.assertion: The client triggers the flow with Results.Challenge using OpenIdConnectChallengeProperties with Prompt = 'create'
assertions.rationale: Client calls Results.Challenge(new OpenIdConnectChallengeProperties { Prompt = "create", ... }, new[] { "oidc" }).

assertions.assertion: The registration handler calls GetAuthorizationContextAsync(returnUrl) and redirects away when it returns null to prevent open redirect
assertions.rationale: OnPostAsync calls GetAuthorizationContextAsync(returnUrl) and returns Redirect("~/") when context == null.

assertions.assertion: The handler signs the user in via HttpContext.SignInAsync(new IdentityServerUser(...)) only after email confirmation, then redirects to returnUrl
assertions.rationale: Registration only creates the user and sends a confirmation email; SignInAsync(new IdentityServerUser(user.SubjectId)) occurs in ConfirmEmail after confirmation, then Redirect(returnUrl).
